corrections.description: First pass claims receipt of fossil present; prior accepted full reading says only expected to find at Geological Society, not personal receipt.
First pass describes memorial without separating catalogue synopsis P1 from actual collective excerpt P2; individual Darwin authorship unproved.
Editorial summary claims great variability while body says precisely same first crop; retain body scope and damaged text, not later generalization.
First pass calls June8 letter; source body gives8th with no month. Personal July1 receipt does not prove postal arrival then.

summary: Eleven targets: nine individually attributed Darwin documents with restrictions, one collective memorial proxy/excerpt and one Salter incoming. Ten fresh full-source readings and three explicitly reused accepted records. No new direct, reverse or knowledge edges; authority-key search found no additional incoming counterpart. Collective signatures and practical subject do not determine individual target eligibility or pairing.
